title: I Opened a ₹2,56,000 Phonak Hearing Aid. Here's What You Actually Get.
pattern: single-device anchor x tier ladder x late inversion
retention_thesis: A four-model comparison leaks viewers the moment someone decides which model is theirs. This map fixes that three ways: (1) the physical I50 stays in frame the whole video, so there is always something to look at that a spec table cannot give; (2) three loops are planted in the hook and NONE resolve before 55%, so nobody can self-select out early; (3) the biggest surprise is an inversion (the cheaper Sphere beats the dearer I90-R) placed at 70%, past the point where comparison videos normally die.

channels 12 / 16 / 20 / 20
the I70 to I90 step covered by a veil

Nothing in this box changes between I30 and I90. That is the point that sets up the whole video

Fitting range is the same on all four. Your hearing loss does not decide your level
Say the AutoSense 7.0 name once here. It comes back at 86%

the ₹ delta on each step
the features each step ADDS, never what the lower one lacks
channels stop at 20 from I70

I50 to I70 is the real jump: 4 features, 4 channels, a year of warranty
Do NOT resolve the I70 to I90 step here. That is the next node

nodes.name: 07-sphere
nodes.beat: The Sphere branch: this is where the AI actually is
must_show: Sphere exists ONLY at I70 and I90
DEEPSONIC is a second chip, not a setting
Spheric Speech Clarity: medium at 70-Sphere, full at 90-Sphere (Phonak's own words)
the I70 and I90 WITHOUT Sphere have no AI at all
talk: CORRECT THE COMMON BELIEF: the I70 and I90 do not have AI. Only the -Sphere versions do
It is a separate, more expensive product, not a feature of the tier
Phonak grades this one honestly themselves: medium vs full strength
Phonak's claims are Phonak's: 3x more likely to understand, 35% less effort. Attribute them

nodes.name: 08-turn
nodes.beat: THE TURN. Closes loop A. ₹2,26,000 for one feature and one program.
must_show: the delta: Speech Enhancer + the AutoSense 'Speech in loud noise' program
SAME 20 channels, SAME 3 year warranty
the source: Phonak's own feature summary, named on the board
talk: Lift the veil that has been on since 0%. This is the loop-A payoff
TWO things, not one. The DB said one; Phonak's document says one feature plus one automatic program. Say two
Name the source out loud. This is Phonak's chart, not my opinion
Do NOT say 'the I90 is a rip-off'. Say what it adds, show what it costs, let the viewer do the arithmetic

nodes.beat: The honest limitation nobody in the category says out loud
must_show: up to 56 hours normally
roughly 10 to 11 hours with Sphere running continuously
the Ultra firmware improved efficiency ~30%
talk: The thing you pay the premium for is the thing that drains the battery
This is not a reason not to buy it. It is a reason to know before you buy it
If you are out 14 hours a day in noise, ask about this specifically

And the Sphere carries a year more warranty

It is why the whole line is now called Ultra
